brief:
Kosovo's decision to participate in a US-led Gaza force reflects the country's dependence on its alliance with Washington, Al Jazeera English reported. Analysts say the move shows how Kosovo's foreign policy priorities align with American strategic interests, particularly regarding Middle Eastern deployments.

The decision exposes the limits of Kosovo's independent decision-making in foreign affairs. As a nation seeking NATO integration and international recognition, Kosovo faces pressure to demonstrate commitment to Western-led initiatives, even when they diverge from regional positions or domestic concerns.
dek: Kosovo's decision to join a US-led Gaza force exposes the pull of its alliance with Washington, according to analysts.
title: Kosovo joins US-led Gaza force amid Washington alignment
